House Bill 641 (COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) By: Representatives Lim of The Senate Committee on Regulated Industries and Utilities offered the 98th, Mathiak of the 82nd, Werkheiser of the 157th, Drenner of the 85th, Lupton of the 83rd, and others following substitute to HB 641:
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Chapter 3 of Title 46 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to electric services, so as to require certain electric suppliers to have in place a written … by electric suppliers generally, by adding a new subsection to read as follows: "(c) Beginning January 1, 2027, any electric supplier that serves residential consumers shall have in place a written policy regarding discontinuation of electric service to residential consumers with who have a serious, life-threatening conditions, condition and have provided the electric supplier with a written statement from a physician, county board of health, hospital, or clinic identifying the such condition and its expected duration, and certifying that the condition would be aggravated by a discontinuation of electric service, and shall furnish such written policy upon request by a consumer or potential consumer."
SECTION 2. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
